Description: Enable Club Members to set a personal reading goal, log page/percentage progress on the active book and see a progress bar toward their goal, on desktop and mobile. (FR-001, NFR-002)
Let Discussion Leads open a discussion thread per chapter/milestone where Club Members can comment, with spoiler-tagged comments hidden until the reader chooses to reveal them. (FR-002, FR-003)
Let Club Members nominate books and vote once in a monthly poll created by the Discussion Lead, with a live, duplicate-proof tally. (FR-004, FR-005, NFR-001)

As a club member, I want to log the page number or percentage I have reached in the current book, so that my progress is saved and I can keep track of where I am.

Acceptance criteria: Progress is saved and still shown after a page refresh.

As a club member, I want to see a progress bar comparing my progress with my personal reading goal, so that I stay motivated and know if I am on schedule.

Acceptance criteria: Progress bar updates immediately after progress is logged.

As a club member, I want to set a target (pages or finish date) for the current book, so that the portal can measure my progress against it.

Acceptance criteria: Goal is stored per member per book and can be edited.

As a club member using a phone, I want the progress input and progress bar to work on a 360px-wide screen, so that I can update my reading from any device.

Acceptance criteria: All progress controls usable from 360px to 1920px width.

As a discussion lead, I want to create a discussion thread for each chapter or reading milestone, so that conversation stays organised by how far members have read.

Acceptance criteria: Thread is linked to exactly one chapter/milestone.

Summary: Story 2.2: Post Comment in Chapter Thread
Description:
As a club member, I want to post comments in a chapter's discussion thread, so that I can share my thoughts with others at the same point in the book.

Acceptance criteria: Comment appears only under the correct chapter thread.

As a club member, I want to mark my comment as a spoiler, so that members who are behind are not shown plot reveals.

Acceptance criteria: Spoiler text is blurred and excluded from previews, notifications and search.

As a club member, I want to click to reveal a spoiler, or have it shown once I mark the chapter as read, so that I only see spoilers when I am ready.

Acceptance criteria: Spoiler stays hidden until clicked or chapter marked as read.

As a club member, I want to nominate a book with its title, author and a short reason, so that my suggestion can be considered for the next monthly poll.

Acceptance criteria: Nomination without title or author is rejected.

As a discussion lead, I want to review all nominations in one queue, so that I can choose which books go into the poll.

Acceptance criteria: All valid nominations appear in the lead's queue.

As a discussion lead, I want to create a monthly poll from the nominated books, so that the club can vote on the next book.

Acceptance criteria: Poll lists the selected nominations and has an open/close date.

Summary: Story 3.4: Cast One Vote Per Poll
Description:
As a club member, I want to cast exactly one vote in the monthly poll, so that the next book is chosen fairly.

Acceptance criteria: A second vote by the same member in the same poll is refused.

As a club member, I want to see the vote count update in real time, so that I know which book is winning without refreshing.

Acceptance criteria: Tally updates within 2 seconds, no duplicate votes under peak load.
